bugs.error_message: Requested duplicate-live-error commit conflicted with the existing hook and RootLayout extraction.

bugs.error_message: Historical scan accepted a committed then deleted copied skill.

bugs.fix: Traverse authenticated tree entries from commit/direct-ref/tag roots, preserving prefixes and reused-tree contexts; SHA1/SHA256 and both skill roots are regressed.

bugs.error_message: Allowed local-projects/.gitkeep caused a historical tracked-user-data refusal.
bugs.root_cause: A directory entry was treated as a complete user-data file path.
bugs.fix: Apply file-path policy to full leaf paths, retain directory-name privacy, and regress allowed placeholder versus nested actual user data.

bugs.error_message: Ordinary JSON-escaped Windows home paths passed publication scans.
bugs.root_cause: Only raw text was classified, without JSON string decoding.
bugs.fix: Scan raw content and one validated JSON string layer; regress Unicode escapes, current/index/history, gzip/UTF16 and sanitized findings.

bugs.error_message: First extraction patch hid sensitive strings after malformed tokens and retried escaped quotes quadratically.
bugs.root_cause: A valid-token-only unanchored matcher restarted at closing quotes and across incomplete escaped spans.
bugs.fix: Consume complete quoted or unterminated spans once, validate syntax, then parse; malformed-prefix controls and bounded128KiB stress pass without raising deadlines.

bugs.error_message: Initial contextual traversal expanded compact DAGs exponentially; a deep-chain regression exceeded its10000ms bound.
bugs.root_cause: Visited keys included full prefixes without context limits; cumulative limits alone ran after expensive long-prefix classification.
bugs.fix: Fail closed before classification at4096 path bytes, with100000-context and32MiB cumulative-key caps. Independent compact/deep/stress regressions pass; preserve failed attempts.

bugs.error_message: Retrospective runtime probe expected operational databasePath in the API health response.
bugs.root_cause: The harness used /api/health instead of the /health operational response for active database identity.
bugs.fix: Correct only the disposable probe endpoint and rerun against a fresh database. Preserve the original failed attempt; no product defect claimed.

bugs.error_message: Synthetic publication probe was blocked by its own committed synthetic policy term.
bugs.root_cause: The initial harness placed policy input inside its disposable scanned Git repository.
bugs.fix: Keep policy outside the fixture repository as existing tests do, rerun full probes, and retain the diagnostic as expected scanner behavior rather than a product defect.

bugs.error_message: complete-surface attachment no-effect assertion compared persisted mimeType:null with constructor mimeType:undefined.
bugs.root_cause: Recovered regression used the repository creation return value rather than the SQLite readback baseline.
bugs.fix: Capture actual stored attachments before the refused request and compare exact durable rows afterward.

bugs.error_message: Shared Agent push/sync planning accepted disabled Agent access.
bugs.root_cause: Planning checked Agent access only in import mode and did not capture non-human map ownership across provider awaits.
bugs.fix: Validate shared Agent GitHub preparation for all planning modes and revalidate its captured map/connection after awaits; assert three disabled modes leave durable state and providers untouched.

bugs.error_message: Cannot find module vitest/vitest.mjs
bugs.root_cause: Declared dependencies were missing.
bugs.fix: Restored unchanged frozen-lockfile dependencies with Node 24.

bugs.error_message: TS2345 editable template string assignment
bugs.root_cause: Central const copy narrowed editable state to literal types.
bugs.fix: Typed editable template state fields as strings.

bugs.error_message: TS2345 number | undefined count
bugs.root_cause: Indexed report counts may be absent under strict indexing.
bugs.fix: Formatter accepts an optional count and preserves the prior empty display.

bugs.error_message: Seed title assertion order mismatch
bugs.root_cause: Snapshot order is independent of insertion order.
bugs.fix: Sorted titles for the existing seed-content assertion.

bugs.error_message: Render assertion expected Markdown capitalization
bugs.root_cause: Existing copy uses lowercase markdown.
bugs.fix: Preserved the wording and corrected the assertion.

bugs.error_message: CLI fixture exited zero without scanning
bugs.root_cause: macOS temporary-directory symlinks differ between module URL and argv.
bugs.fix: Compared resolved real paths and added a real CLI violation regression.

bugs.error_message: Capital sharp S and decomposed umlauts bypassed hygiene
bugs.root_cause: Literal matching lacked normalization and case folding.
bugs.fix: Normalized NFC and used Unicode case-insensitive forbidden-character matching with regressions.

bugs.error_message: Rendered GitHub labels omitted spaces
bugs.root_cause: Extracted fragments omitted their separating spaces.
bugs.fix: Restored trailing spaces and asserted static rendered messages.

bugs.error_message: Binary and parenthesized JSX copy escaped regression guard
bugs.root_cause: The AST guard recognized too few direct expression forms.
bugs.fix: Covered direct binary and parenthesized expressions with positive and negative fixtures.

bugs.error_message: Root tests did not run hygiene regressions
bugs.root_cause: Node test files are outside workspace Vitest discovery.
bugs.fix: Run the Node regression suite before workspace tests in the root test command.

bugs.error_message: Date assertion did not execute the actual exporter
bugs.root_cause: A separate Date formatting assertion was a surrogate for production Intl formatting.
bugs.fix: Asserted the actual downloaded HTML Blob under a fixed clock, including central display labels and unchanged filename.

bugs.error_message: Unimplemented pathspec magic underscore
bugs.root_cause: The workspace Git wrapper does not support exclusion pathspec syntax.
bugs.fix: Stage an explicit changed-file list filtered to omit orchestrator-owned sprint status.

bugs.error_message: Invalid patch: multiple operations target STATUS.md
bugs.root_cause: A delete and add operation targeted the same file in one patch.
bugs.fix: Replaced the handoff with a single file write.

bugs.error_message: Template interpolation literals and custom label attributes escaped JSX copy guard
bugs.root_cause: The checked-in guard did not include the two repairs recorded in the supplied specification.
bugs.fix: Recurse into template span expressions, scan custom labels, and assert literal/nonliteral and option-value cases.

bugs.error_message: Operation summary formatting remained outside central copy and assertion/array expressions bypassed the JSX guard
bugs.root_cause: The migration missed the operation-summary formatter and the guard did not unwrap assertions or inspect child arrays.
bugs.fix: Moved the formatter unchanged into panelStrings and added assertion/array recursion with literal, central-string, protocol and grouping regressions.

bugs.error_message: GitHub Sync tab icon touches its label
bugs.root_cause: String extraction replaced "/> GitHub Sync" with "/>{strings.githubSync}", dropping the literal space; .view-tabs a has no flex gap.
bugs.fix: Restored JSX whitespace before the central string; other icon sites sit in flex containers with gap.

bugs.error_message: GET / returned 403 with static plugin index disabled
bugs.root_cause: Automatic directory index was disabled without a root handler.
bugs.fix: Explicit root entry-point route; real HTML/HEAD tests pass.

bugs.error_message: URIError on POST /foo%ZZ terminated Node
bugs.root_cause: Not-found callback decoded unsupported-method URL outside ordinary error handling.
bugs.fix: Route only navigation methods; malformed URL handling remains within async route and returns JSON.

bugs.error_message: ENOENT from static allowedPath escaped unawaited sender
bugs.root_cause: Existence check and realpath lookup could race during rebuild.
bugs.fix: Single realpath lookup with focused missing/not-directory handling; removed assets return JSON 404.

bugs.error_message: ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE from decoded NUL asset path
bugs.root_cause: URL decoding permitted NUL through to filesystem path validation.
bugs.fix: Reject NUL as malformed URL before static sender; GET/HEAD survival coverage.

bugs.error_message: ENAMETOOLONG from long asset name terminated Node
bugs.root_cause: Static callback rethrew filename-limit errors from user-controlled URL.
bugs.fix: Narrow ENAMETOOLONG unavailable-file handling with JSON 404 and healthy API regression.

bugs.error_message: Malformed POST test expected 404 but router returned 400
bugs.root_cause: Fastify rejects malformed percent escapes before custom routing.
bugs.fix: Assert the required JSON 400 response and continued health; NUL unsupported-method response remains JSON 404.

bugs.error_message: Local Node 24 was not found at verify.ps1:89
bugs.root_cause: Existing verifier only discovers the Windows repository-local runtime.
bugs.fix: Recorded platform limitation and ran compatible Node 24/Corepack tests/build/typecheck; portability remains Story 1.3.

bugs.error_message: Missing-build regressions renamed shared web output
bugs.root_cause: First test design mutated apps/web/dist and assumed file-symlink privileges.
bugs.fix: Internal build-directory injection and per-test real-build copies; Windows directory-junction containment fixture.

bugs.error_message: Raw ENOENT if index disappears before startup stat
bugs.root_cause: Stat after realpath did not permit missing entry.
bugs.fix: Use throwIfNoEntry:false to retain the named actionable build error.

bugs.error_message: PAUSED: manual rollback after 1-3 dev session stalled; agent left status:blocked for missing Windows runner
bugs.root_cause: In-place isolation with rollback_on_failure=false pauses on stall; Codex marked Story 1.3 blocked (no Windows runner) then went idle without a clean Stop, so bmad-loop stalled instead of harvesting a terminal result. status:blocked also pauses the unattended run even on clean exit.
bugs.fix: Enabled scm.rollback_on_failure; removed Windows-only Codex plugin ai-software-architect (hook exit 126); cerebrum: missing Windows acceptance → deferred + done, not blocked; hard-reset/stash attempt and resume.

bugs.error_message: verify deferred 1-3: tests got 'Node 24 is required' under ctl PATH (Node 22)
bugs.root_cause: bmad-loop engine/ctl inherits ~/.local/bin Node 22; portable scripts require Node 24.
bugs.fix: Prefix [verify].commands with PATH=.../nvm/.../v24.17.0/bin:$PATH; document in cerebrum/docs.

bugs.error_message: Escaped quote/backslash diagnostic values leaked
bugs.root_cause: Raw substring redaction missed JSON serialization and quoted-value patterns ended at escaped quotes.
bugs.fix: Redact raw/serialized env values and consume complete escaped credential strings.

bugs.error_message: Debug stderr hidden and lifetime buffer grew indefinitely
bugs.root_cause: Server stderr was accumulated without forwarding or a size bound.
bugs.fix: Stream redacted debug lines; retain 16 KiB tail and omit overlong lines safely.

bugs.error_message: Doctor passed an incomplete fastify package
bugs.root_cause: Dependency check tested only package.json existence.
bugs.fix: Resolve required current dependency entries and check readable targets without executing application code.

bugs.error_message: Doctor passed empty Corepack file
bugs.root_cause: PATH entry presence was mistaken for a usable Corepack.
bugs.fix: Run local --version with network/bootstrap disabled and validate version; preserve no-cache acceptance.

bugs.error_message: Directory named index.html passed doctor
bugs.root_cause: Web entry check used existsSync only.
bugs.fix: Require a readable regular file in doctor and launcher.

bugs.error_message: Normal build repair referred to a suppressed error
bugs.root_cause: Captured non-ERR compiler diagnostics were shown only under debug.
bugs.fix: Include one concise redacted underlying cause without stack lines.

bugs.error_message: Doctor repair loop for inaccessible Project database
bugs.root_cause: Generic startup repair pointed to read-only doctor, which intentionally never opens Project databases.
bugs.fix: Give writable directory/database-file repair for mkdir and SQLite open/read-only errors.

bugs.error_message: Unreadable .env misclassified as Project database directory
bugs.root_cause: New filesystem-code mapping initially ignored the operation that raised the error.
bugs.fix: Restrict filesystem database mapping to syscall mkdir; retain SQLite codes/messages and regress unrelated .env errors.

bugs.error_message: Root .env port repair ineffective with process PORT
bugs.root_cause: Repair text omitted environment-over-.env precedence.
bugs.fix: Name changing/removing process override or updating .env; cover occupied-port output.

bugs.error_message: Doctor accepted arbitrarily large health response
bugs.root_cause: response.json buffered and parsed whole body despite a time limit.
bugs.fix: Stream at most 16 KiB before parsing; reject oversize with action and keep two-second deadline.

bugs.error_message: Native constructor probe could be removed without failing tests
bugs.root_cause: Failure injection occurred during package load rather than native-addon construction.
bugs.fix: Allow JavaScript load and fail actual .node addon load, checking attempt markers and persistent-data snapshot.

bugs.error_message: Successful owned server env precedence was unprotected
bugs.root_cause: Existing config start test stopped at occupied-port preflight.
bugs.fix: Exercise successful owned server/browser with conflicting root/server ports from unrelated cwd.

bugs.error_message: Database path regression expected ENOTDIR but macOS returned EEXIST
bugs.root_cause: mkdir recursive raises platform-specific EEXIST for a regular file at the target directory.
bugs.fix: Handle demonstrated mkdir EEXIST with concrete database directory repair.

bugs.error_message: Constructor fixture did not intercept installed native addon
bugs.root_cause: Installed prebuilt SQLite addon filename differed from a fixed expected basename.
bugs.fix: Intercept actual .node loads inside the better-sqlite3 package.

bugs.error_message: Wrong reference: config should be signal
bugs.root_cause: Used "config" instead of "signal"
bugs.fix: Changed config → signal

bugs.error_message: Wrong condition in logic
bugs.root_cause: Condition was: if (/HOST|PORT/.test(cause.message)
bugs.fix: Changed to: if (/^(Strict local mode requires HOST|PORT must be)

bugs.error_message: Wrong reference: ipc should be extra
bugs.root_cause: Used "ipc" instead of "extra"
bugs.fix: Changed ipc → extra

bugs.error_message: Wrong reference: env should be cwd
bugs.root_cause: Used "env" instead of "cwd"
bugs.fix: Changed env → cwd

bugs.error_message: Final unterminated server stdout line absent from deterministic verification
bugs.root_cause: The test interrupted after a newline chunk, before the final timer wrote its unterminated chunk.
bugs.fix: Wait for the final write callback marker and owned browser readiness; preserve absence while live and presence after EOF.

bugs.error_message: Direct-server bind regression saw a missing web build during parent verification
bugs.root_cause: Parent ran pnpm test concurrently with the release build; Vite cleared output while a fixture copied it.
bugs.fix: Run tests and release verification serially; the original 117-test rerun passed before review patches.

bugs.error_message: Split UTF-8 byte chunks corrupted credentials before diagnostic redaction
bugs.root_cause: Each Buffer was independently coerced to string, replacing split multibyte sequences.
bugs.fix: Set UTF-8 encoding on captured stdout/stderr and cover public setup failures on both streams in normal/debug mode.

bugs.error_message: Line-based forwarding exposed multiline credential fragments
bugs.root_cause: Environment redaction matched only the full raw/serialized secret while stdout/stderr forwarding processed individual lines.
bugs.fix: Redact full values first, then nonempty raw/serialized line fragments; formatter and real start output regressions pass.

bugs.error_message: Malformed installed dependency metadata escaped without Next action
bugs.root_cause: Installed package metadata was parsed outside the validator’s known incomplete-package failure handling.
bugs.fix: Map known parse/read failures to the existing incomplete dependency result with setup action; cover public start and doctor without side effects.

bugs.error_message: Immediate server exit could truncate pending piped diagnostic output
bugs.root_cause: Direct startup exited without waiting for the stderr write callback.
bugs.fix: Exit in the write callback; a large direct-server debug regression checks end marker, trailing stack and final newline.

bugs.error_message: Synthetic unbroken diagnostic word exceeded fixture timeout
bugs.root_cause: A 256 KiB unbroken word triggered expensive existing redaction regex scanning, obscuring the pipe-flush test.
bugs.fix: Use a similarly large payload of ordinary diagnostic words; retain all end-of-stream assertions. This is a fixture correction, not a production redaction-performance change.

bugs.error_message: Short-secret formatter expectation assumed replacement marker stability
bugs.root_cause: Existing redaction can remask its replacement marker when a one-character secret appears in that marker.
bugs.fix: Use x/y fragments to verify existing short-secret eligibility without changing the previously accepted masking policy.

bugs.error_message: Portable setup fixture omitted newly created source files
bugs.root_cause: Fixture copies use tracked paths; new files had not yet been staged.
bugs.fix: Stage/commit owned new sources before the Git-based portable checkout gate. Story4.4 continuation: initial full scripts fixture omitted untracked proposal-templates.ts; complete configured workspace rerun after the authorized commit passes all1,208 tests.

bugs.error_message: Template/checklist schema rejected current source shape
bugs.root_cause: Core tests resolved the previous compiled contracts package.
bugs.fix: Resolve contracts to source in the core Vitest configuration.

bugs.error_message: Sample removal deleted scoped Personas/statuses and left roadmap target references
bugs.root_cause: Physical deletion cascaded scoped entities and erased polymorphic reference targets.
bugs.fix: Use logical removal with visible aggregate reads and preserve scoped customization public behavior.

bugs.error_message: Entity survived completion/audit failure
bugs.root_cause: Entity writes and onboarding initialization/completion were separate commits.
bugs.fix: Wrap existing Project/map/Card/GitHub operations in transactions and assert rollback.

bugs.error_message: Successful archive download left checklist pending
bugs.root_cause: Location navigation did not await generation or invalidate checklist queries.
bugs.fix: Await response/blob, trigger the download and invalidate progress; expose failures.

bugs.error_message: Removed sample Cards prevented status deletion
bugs.root_cause: Status usage counted logically removed map Cards.
bugs.fix: Count only visible Card usage; preserve visible-use rejection.

bugs.error_message: Card/connector writes accepted removed map targets before failing
bugs.root_cause: Individual writes and import planning lacked visibility validation before writes/auth/network.
bugs.fix: Validate newly supplied map/Card/Release targets before effects; preserve existing either-visible links.

bugs.error_message: Historical failed export label marked onboarding complete
bugs.root_cause: Export audit labels were written before generation succeeded.
bugs.fix: Recognize only the durable successful-export marker; test old failed/unknown labels.

bugs.error_message: Removal recreated intentionally empty workflow statuses
bugs.root_cause: Snapshot lookup initializes default statuses as a read side effect.
bugs.fix: Use direct visible map-row lookup during removal; verify unchanged empty statuses after reopen.

bugs.error_message: Retained sample customizations became unavailable through combined endpoint
bugs.root_cause: Annotation/template read guards rejected removed map scope in the combined response.
bugs.fix: Retain read availability for existing scoped customization while keeping aggregate mutation guards.

bugs.error_message: Export rollback regression bypassed serialization after self-event insertion
bugs.root_cause: Mocking the entire export implementation did not exercise the transaction path.
bugs.fix: Force actual audit serialization failure after self-event insertion and compare unchanged state.

bugs.error_message: Legacy evidence deleted before first checklist read lost sticky progress
bugs.root_cause: Initialization persisted the marker but recognition waited for an API read.
bugs.fix: Recognize matching known data within initialization; test removal before first read.

bugs.error_message: Attachment deletion mutated a removed map without audit
bugs.root_cause: Card visibility was checked only after the attachment was deleted.
bugs.fix: Reject unavailable Cards before deletion; public DELETE leaves attachment/events unchanged.

bugs.error_message: Disabled/removed connector target validation created workflow defaults or entered auth
bugs.root_cause: Snapshot lookup has default-status side effects and sync resolved auth before visibility.
bugs.fix: Use side-effect-free map listing before plan/import/sync auth; test unchanged state and no auth.

bugs.error_message: Visual export completion persisted despite checklist initialization failure
bugs.root_cause: Completion and returned checklist state were separate transactions.
bugs.fix: Return checklist(s) inside the existing all-Project completion transaction; force initialization failure.

bugs.error_message: Pure planner accepted Note below Story or Note
bugs.root_cause: Hierarchy condition omitted Note parent rules.
bugs.fix: Extend the existing hierarchy condition; test valid and invalid Note parents.

bugs.error_message: Retained hidden target bypassed cross-Project GitHub link validation
bugs.root_cause: Visible-scope resolution ignored the retained physical target.
bugs.fix: Compare both physical target Project scopes before updating; test both orientations.

bugs.error_message: moveCard accepted hidden or visible foreign Release assignment
bugs.root_cause: Movement validated only parents and wrote releaseId directly.
bugs.fix: Invoke the existing Release guard before writes; assert all persisted state unchanged.

bugs.error_message: HTTP sync regression expected 403 but got schema 500
bugs.root_cause: The fixture omitted the existing required confirm:true property.
bugs.fix: Correct the fixture only; focused HTTP suite passes.

bugs.error_message: Type error
bugs.root_cause: Missing or incorrect type annotation
bugs.fix: Added type assertion/annotation

bugs.error_message: Incorrect value in code
bugs.root_cause: Had "now-next-later"
bugs.fix: Changed to "simple"

bugs.error_message: ZodError: missing Card parentId/releaseId/position
bugs.root_cause: Initial DOM fixture omitted required nullable/position fields and used long labels for B/I buttons.
bugs.fix: Use complete contract-validated sample hierarchy and exact current toolbar labels; DOM regressions pass.

bugs.error_message: TS2769 incompatible Vite PluginOption types
bugs.root_cause: Vitest 2 bundles Vite 5 while application plugin targets Vite 6. Importing its defineConfig changed production config typing.
bugs.fix: Keep application Vite config unchanged and use a per-file Vitest environment directive for the DOM test.

bugs.error_message: FR-15 regression could pass when the current push-plan Issue body is empty
bugs.root_cause: Legacy issue-dry-run asserts a different consumer path from the Card modal push plan.
bugs.fix: Assert Markdown on the actual local work-item plan HTTP response with an enabled writable fixture connector; no auth or network.

bugs.error_message: HTTP fixture setup failures bypass resource cleanup
bugs.root_cause: Database/seed/route initialization ran before try/finally.
bugs.fix: Protect setup immediately after temporary-directory creation; nested finally closes whichever server/DB initialized and removes owned data.

bugs.error_message: Observed List formatting had no toolbar regression
bugs.root_cause: Initial DOM test exercised B/I/H2 only, despite live List evidence.
bugs.fix: Extend the same real-editor save/remount case with List Markdown and rendered bullet/emphasis assertions.

bugs.error_message: TS2347 Untyped function calls may not accept type arguments; TS7006 item implicitly any
bugs.root_cause: ReturnType on the overloaded Fastify factory erased the response typing in the optional cleanup handle. Focused runtime tests did not run TypeScript checking.
bugs.fix: Declare the handle as FastifyInstance and run server typecheck plus focused test before full gates.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named yaml in terminal metadata check
bugs.root_cause: The ad hoc frontmatter check assumed system Python had PyYAML installed.
bugs.fix: Parse the complete frontmatter with the existing Ruby YAML parser instead; terminal metadata validation passed without adding dependencies.

bugs.error_message: Card mutations can persist partial state and falsely attribute actor history.
bugs.root_cause: Card writes, versions and events used separate writes; actor was hardcoded.
bugs.fix: Actor-aware synchronous UoW binds all writes to one active transaction and persists actor/session history.

bugs.error_message: Root helper writes and read-looking initialization bypass transaction enforcement.
bugs.root_cause: Transitive helpers and stores exposed writer paths; initialization happened on reads.
bugs.fix: Guard every writer and helper, keep reads pure, and initialize explicitly inside UoW.

bugs.error_message: Vitest cannot resolve new db aggregate subpath imports.
bugs.root_cause: A package-root file alias does not resolve db subpath imports.
bugs.fix: Map db subpaths to the source directory while retaining the package entry alias.

bugs.error_message: Native diagnostics require better-sqlite3 outside packages/db.
bugs.root_cause: Initial import investigation covered apps/packages TypeScript but missed script MJS.
bugs.fix: Move the in-memory native probe into packages/db; scan all tracked source extensions.

bugs.error_message: Successful remote creations lost after a later provider failure
bugs.root_cause: Remote results were buffered until the entire provider loop completed.
bugs.fix: Commit each successful remote result with its legacy link and activity in a synchronous UoW before the next network call; create applied runs only after all phases succeed.

bugs.error_message: Concurrent human edits crashed sync or were hashed as sent
bugs.root_cause: The local commit reread Cards and dereferenced absent push results or hashed fresh unsent content.
bugs.fix: Track actual outgoing payloads; retain their hashes and keep concurrent local edits unsynced, including earlier results edited during later network calls.

bugs.error_message: Rejected async transaction callbacks/hooks could create unhandled rejections
bugs.root_cause: Runtime sync guards rejected returned Promises without observing their later rejection.
bugs.fix: Observe unsupported Promise results while throwing explicit synchronous-contract errors; expire rolled-back repositories and keep hook failures after commit.

bugs.error_message: Parking changedFields assertion also received existing nullable-field transitions
bugs.root_cause: Initial create snapshots omit optional fields while persisted later snapshots contain null.
bugs.fix: Assert parked membership without changing existing nullable snapshot semantics.

bugs.error_message: TS2322: SyncPlan item.cardId can be undefined in a push phase
bugs.root_cause: The shared SyncPlan item schema includes import entries without local Card identities, and a callback did not preserve the required push-id narrowing.
bugs.fix: Validate and bind the Card id before invoking the provider and use that narrowed identity in the synchronous result phase.

bugs.error_message: Source-file import performs readFileSync inside a SQLite transaction.
bugs.root_cause: Moving the existing import writer into UoW also moved filesystem reads into its synchronous body.
bugs.fix: Prepare content in HTTP before entering UoW; require prepared content in the contracts type/schema and test actual file deletion at Tx entry.

bugs.error_message: Validated attribution can be mutated to an empty actor during a transaction.
bugs.root_cause: Validation returned a mutable object exposed through the repository actor getter.
bugs.fix: Freeze validated actor context and expose readonly actor typing; assert mutation fails and persisted identity remains original.

bugs.error_message: Parked-only Card versions report an empty changedFields list.
bugs.root_cause: New park/unpark version persistence reused a field comparison list that omitted parked.
bugs.fix: Include parked and verify both direction changes in persisted history.

bugs.error_message: Repeated-Card ChangeSet baseline regression depends on millisecond timing.
bugs.root_cause: Original and first-update timestamps could coincide, allowing inter-operation timestamp checks to escape detection.
bugs.fix: Advance the mocked clock by one second for application and restore real timers in finally.

bugs.error_message: Omitted hierarchy override was reset or replayed from a stale link
bugs.root_cause: Upsert defaulted omitted overrides to false, while result phases spread override values captured before network waits.
bugs.fix: Preserve the current persisted override when omitted; result updates exclude captured overrides. Cover existing and provider-intervening moves through push and sync.

bugs.error_message: Prepared remote responses could write a replacement DB retaining the same IDs
bugs.root_cause: Result phases relied on matching entity IDs rather than the identity of the database that supplied their preparation.
bugs.fix: Capture the internal database identity and reject replacement after every awaited preparation phase before result writes. Cover copied-ID replacement during authentication, fetch, push, import, plan and pull.

bugs.error_message: Markdown audit exports omitted actor identity and MCP session
bugs.root_cause: The export rendered only actorType after attribution was added to persistence.
bugs.fix: Render actor identity and optional MCP session; verify distinct agent identities through exportAudit.

bugs.error_message: Clock rollback pruned a newly published restore point
bugs.root_cause: Retention sorted wall-clock timestamps, which can move backward.
bugs.fix: Persist a monotonic publication sequence and exercise manual and protected migration retention under clock rollback.

bugs.error_message: Colocated databases listed and deleted each other's restore points
bugs.root_cause: The snapshots directory was shared and filenames had no source identity.
bugs.fix: Namespace files with a hash of the source basename; filter listing and retention by that identity and test two real colocated databases.

bugs.error_message: An awaited migration continuation could write after rollback
bugs.root_cause: Async callbacks received a writable database before returned-Promise rejection.
bugs.fix: Reject async and bound async functions before invocation; verify no delayed callback write.

bugs.error_message: A published point stayed absent from the UI after retention failed
bugs.root_cause: Only success invalidated listing, and failure copy incorrectly implied no publication.
bugs.fix: Refetch after settled operations and preserve the concrete published-but-retention-failed cause with truthful action-error wording.

bugs.error_message: A white filled-button outline disappeared against the white panel
bugs.root_cause: The offset outline used the dark-surface white token outside the button.
bugs.fix: Preserve 2px outline and offset while adding contrasting green and white focus backing; inspect the rendered keyboard indicator.

bugs.error_message: Changing Activity views enabled duplicate creation during an active request
bugs.root_cause: Component-local mutation and ref state were discarded on unmount.
bugs.fix: Use shared keyed mutation state and cache guard; exercise unmount/remount with a deferred request.

bugs.error_message: A 2 GiB cap mutant passed the original retention fixture
bugs.root_cause: The only cap fixture exceeded the cap with protected files alone.
bugs.fix: Add three real 400 MiB sparse files and assert oldest removal and 800 MiB retained.

bugs.error_message: A release build overlapped running workspace tests
bugs.root_cause: The parent treated a still-running session as completed before starting the dependent gate.
bugs.fix: Interrupt the overlapping invocation, wait for workspace completion, then rerun release gates serially.

bugs.error_message: Root node_modules/.bin/tsx was absent during isolated acceptance launch
bugs.root_cause: tsx is installed at the server package scope.
bugs.fix: Use apps/server/node_modules/.bin/tsx with the explicit server tsconfig and an empty disposable working directory.

bugs.error_message: Occupied invalid snapshot output raised file is not a database
bugs.root_cause: The test assumed a different SQLite error for an existing invalid output file.
bugs.fix: Assert the real SQLite cause and cleanup behavior.

bugs.error_message: Vite transformed a test new URL filesystem target
bugs.root_cause: The browser-oriented URL transform changed the intended CSS source path.
bugs.fix: Read the explicit filesystem source path in the test.

bugs.error_message: Earlier Card audit after snapshots show later save fields within one UoW.
bugs.root_cause: Before-commit audit closures retained Card objects mutated by history finalizers.
bugs.fix: Capture an independent after snapshot and reconcile only its committed counter; regression preserves Original to First to Second transitions.

bugs.error_message: Deleted Card history remains readable after its Story Map becomes hidden.
